QuestInfo.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
QuestInfo.0: Riel in Florina Beach asks me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake. I can answer that before I start my work.
QuestInfo.1:
You have to prepare the recipe ingredients for 12 people, then bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.

#i4000029:# #t4000029:# #c4000029# / 12
#i4000136:# #t4000136:# #c4000136# / 5
#i4000043:# #t4000043:# #c4000043# / 20
QuestInfo.2: I answered all the questions that Riel gave me. I passed Riel's tests and she took the recipe for 12 people.

0.0:
I'm sure you know this and all, but I'll still ask. Which of these monsters will you not see at Florina Beach? 

#L0##bTortie#l
#L1#Clang#l
#L2#Croco#l
0.1: I'm glad you know the basic stuff around here. I'm just worried you may wander around and hunt around stuff without knowing what you'll be facing. Well, shall we get this started?

0.0: You'll find Tortie at the right side of the beach...
0.1: One of the more renowned treats at the Florina Beach is the 'Clang's Claw' special!

yes.0:
All right, let me tell you more about this job. I need 5 #t4000136#s to make some coconut juice, 20 #t4000043#s for some tasty food, and 12 #t4000029#s for the dessert. Please get me the freshest materials available! 

 #i4000136# 5 #t4000136#s
#i4000043# 20 #t4000043#s
#i4000029# 12 #t4000029#s

1.0: Have you gathered it all? If the ingredients are not fresh and delicious I may have to garnish your pay. And of course, the quantity needs to be right, too. Shall we check and see?

yes.0: Wow, you got them all! The sweet-smelling coconut... the tasty-looking claws... and the fresh batch of bananas... good job! We have been booking more tourists lately, and I can sure use someone like you again. If you're looking for more work, then come talk to me. I feel like I can trust you to take on some of the harder tasks. I should even raise your pay, then!

item.0: I think you're lacking some materials. Please check and see if you have #b5 Coconuts, 20 Lorang Claws, and 12 Lupin's bananas#k. Can you go out and get the rest of them?
